grammarFocus: 第一条件句；because / therefore；情态动词建议。
title: Pool Training: Environment and First Conditional
instructions: 听录音，完成10个问题。录音会播放两遍。第一遍听大意，第二遍注意细节。答案必须来自录音内容。所有题目均为模拟练习，不是官方考试。
transcript:
A: Hi Mei, you look tired. Are you okay?
B: Yeah, I’m fine. I just finished swimming practice. The pool is very busy today.
A: Oh, I see. Why is the pool so busy?
B: Because the city swimming competition is next month. Many people are training.
A: That makes sense. So, if you practice every day, you will swim faster.
B: Exactly. But I’m worried about the water. The pool water is not very clean today.
A: Really? That’s not good. If the water is dirty, you may get sick.
B: I know. Therefore, I will talk to the coach. He should check the water quality.
A: Good idea. Also, you should drink water after swimming. It’s important.
B: Yes, I always do. But sometimes I forget. I must remember.
A: And you shouldn’t swim immediately after eating. Wait at least thirty minutes.
B: Thanks. I usually wait. But today I was in a hurry.
A: If you are in a hurry, you might feel uncomfortable in the water.
B: You’re right. I will be more careful next time.
A: Also, the pool changing room is very wet. You should wear sandals there.
B: Oh, I didn’t know that. I will wear sandals tomorrow.
A: Great. And if you see any problems, you must tell the coach.
B: Okay, I will. Thanks for the advice.
A: You’re welcome. Good luck with your training!

questions.prompt: Why is the pool very busy today?
options: Because the city swimming competition is next month.
Because the pool is closed for cleaning.
Because many people are on holiday.
answers: Because the city swimming competition is next month.
questions.explanation: 录音中B说“Because the city swimming competition is next month. Many people are training.”，因此泳池忙碌的原因是下个月的城市游泳比赛。
questions.evidence: Because the city swimming competition is next month. Many people are training.

questions.prompt: What will happen if Mei practices every day?
questions.explanation: A说“if you practice every day, you will swim faster.”，所以如果每天练习，她将游得更快。
questions.evidence: if you practice every day, you will swim faster.

questions.prompt: What may happen if the water is dirty?
questions.explanation: A说“If the water is dirty, you may get sick.”，因此如果水脏，Mei可能会生病。
questions.evidence: If the water is dirty, you may get sick.

questions.prompt: What does Mei say she will do about the dirty water?
options: She will talk to the coach.
She will clean the pool herself.
answers: She will talk to the coach.
questions.explanation: B说“Therefore, I will talk to the coach.”，因此Mei将和教练谈谈。
questions.evidence: Therefore, I will talk to the coach.

questions.prompt: What should Mei do after swimming?
questions.explanation: A说“you should drink water after swimming.”，所以Mei游泳后应该喝水。
questions.evidence: you should drink water after swimming.

questions.prompt: How long should Mei wait after eating before swimming?
questions.explanation: A说“Wait at least thirty minutes.”，因此饭后至少等三十分钟。

questions.prompt: What might happen if Mei is in a hurry?
options: She might feel uncomfortable in the water.
answers: She might feel uncomfortable in the water.
questions.explanation: A说“If you are in a hurry, you might feel uncomfortable in the water.”，所以如果匆忙，她可能在水里感到不舒服。
questions.evidence: If you are in a hurry, you might feel uncomfortable in the water.

questions.prompt: What should Mei wear in the changing room?
questions.explanation: A说“You should wear sandals there.”，因此Mei在更衣室应该穿凉鞋。

questions.prompt: What must Mei do if she sees any problems?
questions.explanation: A说“if you see any problems, you must tell the coach.”，所以如果看到问题，Mei必须告诉教练。
questions.evidence: if you see any problems, you must tell the coach.

options: She will talk to the coach.
questions.explanation: B说“I will wear sandals tomorrow.”，因此Mei明天将穿凉鞋。

grammar.title: First Conditional and Modal Verbs for Advice
grammar.explanation: 第一条件句表示如果某事发生，就会有某种结果。结构是：If + 一般现在时，主语 + will/may/might + 动词原形。例如：If it rains, we will stay at home. 情态动词 should 表示建议，must 表示必须，may/might 表示可能。
grammar.example: If you practice every day, you will swim faster.

questions.prompt: If it rains tomorrow, we ______ at home.
questions.explanation: 第一条件句中，主句用 will + 动词原形。因此选 will stay。
questions.evidence: If you practice every day, you will swim faster.

questions.prompt: You ______ drink more water. It’s good for you.
questions.explanation: should 表示建议，符合语境。must not 表示禁止，will 表示将来，都不合适。
questions.evidence: you should drink water after swimming.

questions.prompt: The pool is closed ______ the water is dirty.
questions.explanation: because 表示原因，这里“水脏”是“泳池关闭”的原因。so 表示结果，but 表示转折，都不符合逻辑。
questions.evidence: Because the city swimming competition is next month.

questions.prompt: If you feel tired, you ______ take a rest.
questions.explanation: should 表示建议，这里建议休息。must not 和 will not 都不符合建议的语境。
questions.evidence: you should drink water after swimming.
